notes: The title and description say this Hunt Down deck went 5–1 over the two days at the 2001 Australian Continentals ('huntdown Y2K1 contis deck'), got the author into day 2 and finished 12th overall; the strategy says the only loss was to a WYS deck in the last game of day 2.
Posted 10 August 2001 with no Coruscant-set cards, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

The post has no starting section. Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (posted last, under 'Unknown Type') is the objective and Prepared Defenses is the starting interrupt; Executor: Holotheatre, Executor: Meditation Chamber and Visage Of The Emperor are the cards the objective deploys. All count toward the 60.
The 'Unknown Type(7)' header covers the six locations; with the objective that is seven.
Posted 'Endor Landing Platform (Docking Bay) - Foil' dested the Dark Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay) (Dark); Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay) is the Dark Cloud City site.
Posted 'Secret Plans' and 'Come Here You Big Coward' are listed under Effects in the 60, so they are the Special Edition Effects, not Defensive Shields.
Visage Of The Emperor (unique) is posted x2, kept as published.
